test: Test 4: cluster-pair candidates added to CLIPPER (return support lost by the size gate through clusters of floor obstacles)
written: 2026-10-19, before test4.py was written or run
data: MNO repeated on the saved maps of the frozen B0 release run, all 12 directed pairs, all 337 steps; evaluation uses objects.txt and GT poses only

configs.G2: alpha = 2 (wh_scale_diff 1.7, h_diff 0.2): the object-level way to return gate-rejected pairs
configs.B0+KO: B0 object candidates plus all pairs of oracle clusters (map objects within 0.5 m of an objects.txt box, 0.08 <= z_world < 0.9 m, grouped by GT group, >= 2 members)
configs.B0+KB: B0 object candidates plus all pairs of on-board clusters (test-1 rules: w <= 0.5, 0.08 <= h <= 0.6, |z - z_robot| <= 0.35, single linkage 0.7 m, 2..10 members, radius <= 1.0 m)

cluster_nodes.point: mean XY of members in the robot's odometry frame
cluster_nodes.affinity: object-object pairs: release CLIPPER (sigma 0.15, epsilon 0.25); any pair with a cluster node: same kernel with sigma_G = 0.30, epsilon_G = 0.50 (epsilon_G ~ 90th percentile of group-centre distance inconsistency in test 1; epsilon/sigma ratio kept as in the release)
cluster_nodes.weight: Arun weight of a cluster node scaled by (0.15/0.30)^2 = 0.25 relative to an object with the cluster's youngest member age

metrics: share of steps before B0's first acceptance with a correct measurement (<= 1 m, 5 deg)
number of wrong-mode measurements (> 2 m or > 15 deg)
share of steps with a correct measurement
share of in-mode measurements within the precision threshold
share of measurements whose clique contains cluster nodes; wrong-identity cluster nodes in wrong-mode measurements
decision_rule: Promising if B0+KO reaches at least G2's pre-acceptance coverage AND has at most 75% of G2's wrong-mode measurements. Otherwise cluster candidates are not better than relaxing the gate. B0+KB is reported and does not change the verdict.
status: exploratory, measurement level (no temporal filter); one recording; single CLIPPER run per configuration (test 2 showed run-to-run noise of about 0.3%)
